title: Russia
html:
Russia is a European and Asian country map added to OpenFront in Update 33.0 by RickD004 — Big-map treatment of Russia.

Nations

The map features 82 named nations, including Murmansk, Karelia, Arkhangelsk, Vologda, Komi Republic and Nenets Autonomous Okrug.
